summary: First Rehab is an outpatient physical, occupational and hand therapy practice that opened in 2007 and now runs two New Jersey clinics - Lakewood (1352 River Ave, Unit 3) and Spotswood (404 Main St #A) - staffed by a clinical director, several DPTs and an OT. The website markets both towns but only ever names the Lakewood address, phone, hours and booking option; the Spotswood clinic exists only as a Google Business Profile and directory listings. New patients must submit a Contact Form 7 request (name, diagnosis, referral source, location dropdown limited to Lakewood) or call, and a staff member follows up to schedule.

facts.fact: Practice says it opened in 2007 and describes 'spacious, open gyms, and state-of-the-art equipment'.
Services listed: physical therapy, occupational therapy, hand therapy, plus vestibular/balance therapy, Kinesio taping, an LSVT BIG-certified Parkinson's program and joint-replacement rehab.
Staff page lists six clinicians: Baruch Gottlieb, DPT (Clinical Director) plus four physical therapists and one occupational therapist (Malky Wilschanski, OTR/L).

Locations page shows only the Lakewood clinic (1352 River Avenue, Unit 3, Lakewood NJ 08701), phones 732.884.2020 / 732.200.0954, and hours Mon 8:30-6, Tue 8:30-5, Wed 8:30-5, Thu 8:30-6, Fri 8:00-1:30, with the note 'Hours are subject to change. Please call to confirm.'
Page sitemap contains 14 pages and no Spotswood location page; the newest blog posts date to January 2019.

Google Business Profile 'First Rehab Physical Therapy' at 404 Main St #A, Spotswood NJ 08884: 5.0 from 10 reviews, category 'Occupational therapist', phone (732) 251-6640, website first-rehab.com, hours Mon/Wed/Fri 8AM-4PM, Tue/Thu 8AM-6PM, Sat/Sun closed, and 'Located in: Quality Urns and Statues for Less'.
A second, separate Google listing exists for the town - 'First Rehab Outpatient Therapy Provider Spotswood' (physical therapy clinic) - with no reviews and no website shown.
Birdeye directory profile for the Spotswood address is unclaimed ('This profile has not been claimed by the business owner'), shows 5.0 from 11 reviews and generic Mon-Fri 9-6 hours.

Scheduling page is a Contact Form 7 form with fields Name, Diagnosis, Email, Phone, Location (dropdown offering only 'Lakewood') and Referral source, protected by reCAPTCHA v3; it does not show appointment slots.

FAQ instructs patients to call 732.884.2020 or email info@first-rehab.com for insurance verification ('We work with Medicare and most insurance providers'), says treatment is typically 2-3 visits a week for 4-8 weeks with ~1-hour sessions, and that evaluation notes are sent to the referring physician.

Careers page is a web form whose position dropdown lists Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist, Office Manager, Receptionist, Rehab Aide, Driver and Other, and advertises paid time off, paid holidays, malpractice insurance, flexible schedules and a new-grad mentorship program.

New-patient page asks patients to arrive 15 minutes early to complete a paper packet (general info, medical history, HIPAA) and says 'our scheduling team will help arrange your follow-up appointments' before they leave.

May 2022 local feature in The Voice of Lakewood says First Rehab 'was bought last year by The Towne Group', that a new PT was added because the patient base was growing fast, that it ran Sunday and weeknight hours, and that appointments were booked through a '24-hour call center' at 732-370-2010.

operations_signals: Front door is phone-first: the header of every page shows a click-to-call 732.884.2020 (Lakewood number) plus a 'BOOK NOW' button that leads to a request form, not a calendar (https://first-rehab.com/)

Online scheduling is a request-only Contact Form 7 form asking for diagnosis, referral source and location, with reCAPTCHA v3 and no visible availability - staff must call the patient back to fix a slot (https://first-rehab.com/schedule-an-appointment/)
The form's Location dropdown contains only 'Lakewood', so a Spotswood patient cannot request that clinic online at all (https://first-rehab.com/schedule-an-appointment/)

Insurance benefit verification and general questions are handled by phone or email, not self-service: 'Please call us at 732.884.2020, and we will gladly verify your insurance benefits' (https://first-rehab.com/faqs/)

Paperwork is completed on site 15 minutes before the first visit (paper New Patient Packet), and follow-up appointments are arranged in person by the scheduling team before the patient leaves (https://first-rehab.com/new-patients/)
Lakewood hours are Mon/Thu 8:30-6, Tue/Wed 8:30-5, Fri 8-1:30, closed weekends, and the site itself tells patients hours may change and to call to confirm (https://first-rehab.com/locations/)

Per a 2022 local article, appointment calls were routed to a 24-hour call center (732-370-2010) separate from the clinic's own numbers, and the clinic also ran Sunday and weeknight hours (https://thevoiceoflakewood.com/first-rehab/)

Spotswood keeps a separate local number, (732) 251-6640, on its Google profile while the website publishes only the Lakewood numbers (https://www.google.com/maps/search/First+Rehab+404+Main+St+Spotswood+NJ)
hiring_signals: Careers page accepts applications for Office Manager, Receptionist and Rehab Aide alongside PT/OT and 'Driver' - roles that map to front-desk intake, scheduling and patient transport coordination (https://first-rehab.com/careers-at-first-rehab/)
Careers page promotes 'Training for Career Advancement' and a 'Mentorship program for New Grads', suggesting ongoing clinician recruitment (https://first-rehab.com/careers-at-first-rehab/)

Search results surface a part-time Physical Therapist Assistant posting at 1352 River Avenue, Lakewood at $40-50/hour with flexible scheduling and PTO, requiring an NJ PTA license (https://www.indeed.com/q-therapist-assistant-l-toms-river%2C-nj-jobs.html) - seen only as a search-result summary; the Indeed page itself returned a Cloudflare block

The 2022 Voice of Lakewood feature says a physical therapist was hired 'after Pesach' because the patient base was growing, indicating clinician hiring tied to volume (https://thevoiceoflakewood.com/first-rehab/)
review_themes: Google reviews for the Spotswood profile are uniformly positive (5.0 from 10) and praise a welcoming front desk, staff taking time to explain exercises, and equipment/bracing adjustments; no complaints about waits, billing or scheduling appear in the visible reviews (https://www.google.com/maps/search/First+Rehab+404+Main+St+Spotswood+NJ)
Visible Google reviews are old - roughly 4 to 7 years old - with nothing recent visible on the profile (https://www.google.com/maps/search/First+Rehab+404+Main+St+Spotswood+NJ)

The practice's own testimonial carousel (first-name-only quotes from Lakewood, Toms River, Brick, Howell and Whiting patients) emphasizes feeling like family, one-on-one explanation of each exercise, an uncrowded gym and cleanliness (https://first-rehab.com/)

Review volume is small and split across platforms - 10 on Google, 11 on Birdeye - so there is no large independent corpus to mine for operational complaints (https://reviews.birdeye.com/first-rehab-286008032)
tech_footprint: WordPress site running Yoast SEO, with a WordPress 7.1.4 generator tag, Contact Form 7 (v6.1.7) and reCAPTCHA v3 on forms (https://first-rehab.com/)
No online booking engine, patient portal or live-chat widget on the site - only static pages plus two forms (schedule request and careers) (https://first-rehab.com/)
Analytics stack includes Google Tag Manager/gtag plus a legacy Universal Analytics property (UA-154990986-2) and a Cloudflare Insights beacon (https://first-rehab.com/)
A third-party design proofing script, app.quickreviewer.com/proof/webproof, is still loaded on the live homepage - a leftover from a website review/launch process (https://first-rehab.com/)
Organization JSON-LD exists but contains only name, url, logo and a LinkedIn sameAs - no address, phone, hours or LocalBusiness/MedicalClinic type, and no Spotswood entity (https://first-rehab.com/)
Social presence limited to a Facebook page link (facebook.com/FirstRehabNJ) and LinkedIn; blog content has not been updated since January 2019 (https://first-rehab.com/post-sitemap.xml)
Birdeye profile is unclaimed, so no automated review requests or messaging run through a reputation platform (https://reviews.birdeye.com/first-rehab-286008032)
growth_signals: Two clinics now operate (Lakewood and Spotswood) while the site still presents a single-location practice, suggesting the Spotswood site was added or absorbed without a matching web presence (https://first-rehab.com/locations/)

2021 acquisition by The Towne Group, described in a local feature as having turbocharged the practice's services, with a PT hired during a period of rapid patient growth (https://thevoiceoflakewood.com/first-rehab/)
Site pages were refreshed in March 2026 (lastmod dates across home, about, services, staff) but the Spotswood location was still not added (https://first-rehab.com/page-sitemap.xml)

Service-line expansion signals: LSVT BIG-certified Parkinson's program and an association with the Parkinson's support group Life Spark, plus vestibular/balance and joint-replacement programs (https://first-rehab.com/other/)
Hiring posture is broad and ongoing - clinician, aide, driver, office manager and receptionist roles are all accepted through the careers form (https://first-rehab.com/careers-at-first-rehab/)
physical_signals: Two physical clinics: Lakewood at 1352 River Avenue, Unit 3 (NJ 08701) and Spotswood at 404 Main St #A (NJ 08884) (https://www.google.com/maps/search/First+Rehab+404+Main+St+Spotswood+NJ)

The Spotswood clinic is listed by Google as 'Located in: Quality Urns and Statues for Less', i.e. it occupies space inside or alongside another business rather than a standalone building (https://www.google.com/maps/search/First+Rehab+404+Main+St+Spotswood+NJ)

Facility described on the site as having spacious open gyms and state-of-the-art equipment, and the other-therapy page shows photos of balance machines, bikes, knee ROM devices, taping and Parkinson's equipment (https://first-rehab.com/other/)

A 2022 walkthrough describes a spa-like reception with armchairs and coffee, private treatment rooms with heating pads and towels, and a fully stocked gym where a PT aide guides exercises after one-on-one therapist time (https://thevoiceoflakewood.com/first-rehab/)

The Spotswood Google profile advertises 8AM-4PM Mon/Wed/Fri and 8AM-6PM Tue/Thu with weekends closed - 44 scheduled clinical hours a week by simple arithmetic (https://www.google.com/maps/search/First+Rehab+404+Main+St+Spotswood+NJ)
decision_maker: Baruch Gottlieb, DPT, Clinical Director - https://first-rehab.com/staff/ . Practice ownership is attributed to The Towne Group in a 2022 local feature (https://thevoiceoflakewood.com/first-rehab/); no individual owner is named on the company site.

inferences.inference: The front desk is the operational bottleneck: staff triage every web request, verify insurance by phone, arrange follow-ups in person and answer hours questions that the site tells patients to call about.
inferences.reasoning: The only intake channels are a free-text request form (diagnosis + referral source, no availability), a published phone number and an info@ email; the FAQ routes insurance verification to a phone call and the new-patient page has the scheduling team book follow-ups manually.

inferences.inference: Spotswood patients are effectively routed toward Lakewood by the website, which likely leaks local search demand and creates callback confusion.
inferences.reasoning: Google's Spotswood profile links to first-rehab.com, but every page shows the Lakewood address, the Lakewood phone 732.884.2020, Lakewood hours and a Location dropdown with only 'Lakewood'; the Spotswood number (732) 251-6640 appears only on the Google profile.

inferences.inference: Scheduling is phone-and-callback based rather than self-service, so after-hours or overflow calls are the likeliest failure point.
inferences.reasoning: No calendar or booking engine exists on the WordPress site; a 2022 article says bookings ran through a separate 24-hour call center; the site still says to call to confirm hours. Whether that call center is still in use is unverified.

inferences.inference: There is almost no review-generation or reputation workflow, so the Spotswood clinic's visible social proof is thin and dated relative to its patient volume.
inferences.reasoning: Google shows 10 reviews with the newest roughly four years old, the Birdeye profile is unclaimed, and a second unclaimed Google listing exists for the same town - all consistent with no systematic review requests.

inferences.inference: The practice is a plausible buyer for AI intake automation because it combines insurance-heavy intake, two-site coordination and a multi-clinician payroll with no software layer beyond WordPress forms.
inferences.reasoning: Six clinicians plus front-desk, aide and driver roles; insurance verification by phone; evaluation notes sent to referring physicians; tech stack limited to WordPress, Contact Form 7 and reCAPTCHA.

data_gaps: The company website never mentions Spotswood - no address, hours, phone or therapist list for that clinic - so its staffing, services and opening date are unverified; only the Google profile and third-party directories carry them.

Indeed, LinkedIn and Cylex all returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks, so the part-time PTA posting and any employee-count figure could not be confirmed on the source page; the PTA details come from a search-result summary only.
The 24-hour call center (732-370-2010), Sunday hours and Towne Group ownership come from a May 2022 local feature and may be out of date; current ownership and after-hours coverage are unconfirmed.
No Yelp listing, no recent review text and no public negative reviews were found, so complaint themes (billing, waits, no-shows) could not be established.
No public records were checked for square footage, treatment-room or equipment counts, patient volume or insurance mix; the practice publishes none of these.
Google review counts differ by source (10 on Google, 11 on Birdeye, and a third-party aggregator claimed 53), so exact review volume is uncertain.
